name: Stefan Bodescu
goals:
Join a D&D game without having to study too many rules
"Pick up and play" experience
frustrations:
Rules are too complicated and too many
Often forgets planned meetings or where his character sheet is
A campaign takes too long, the busy schedule doesn't encourage his curiosity for the game
scenarios: He doesn't have time to make this a "full time hobby"; he plays D&D strictly for socializing, mostly at a drink with his friends. The rulebooks and complex campaigns give him a headache. The smartphone app is enough for him, it provides a safe way to keep him aware of scheduled nights, personal character sheets and a quick guide for rules. He is not interested about the VR googles and the immersive experience, the application is a good tool for an occasional game night.
